active_gesture_caption.title: Explain the active tool gesture beside the canvas
active_gesture_caption.response: Show concise contextual instructions when a tool is selected, including the clip click required by Duplicate; retain immediate context-menu commands.
active_gesture_caption.acceptance: Choosing Duplicate exposes its gesture without opening Help; clicking a clip still duplicates, and changing tools keeps the music unchanged.

numeric_pad.title: Exact numeric values using only the mouse
numeric_pad.response: Add the shared numeric pad to timing/tempo fields and generator fields; preserve precise values, Apply/Cancel and Undo semantics. Generator Start/Length retain their intentional whole-bar constraint and reject fractions.
numeric_pad.acceptance: Enter exact values by mouse without forced repeated stepping or a hidden drag requirement: clip/tempo/loop fields accept fractional values within their domains; generator Start/Length accept whole bars and visibly reject fractional input.

stable_generator_actions.title: Keep generator actions fixed after an addition
stable_generator_actions.response: Reserve feedback space and stable Add notes / Next range action geometry as generator status changes.
stable_generator_actions.acceptance: Repeated additions and range advances remain reachable at the same pointer coordinates after the first addition; note edits and Undo remain correct.

explicit_retry_playback.title: Expose recovery as Retry playback
explicit_retry_playback.response: Offer a visible retry action after a terminal output failure, rebuilding the failed engine at the current cursor. Preserve the backend cause and avoid automatic retry.
explicit_retry_playback.acceptance: The visible action creates a fresh healthy stream without project/history changes and remains separate from nonfatal dropout notices. Actual ALSA EIO remains a platform/backend limitation, not claimed eliminated.

recent_exports.title: Keep recent WAV and MIDI results visible together
recent_exports.response: Retain separate recent export results and paths so a later MIDI completion cannot hide whether WAV export completed.
recent_exports.acceptance: Sequential WAV/MIDI exports retain both outcomes and destinations; ongoing or failed work remains accurately distinguished from success.
